Candidates: Pablo Hernández de Cos (ES, BIS head) vs Klaas Knot (NL) – only two nominees (Eurogroup statement 6 Nov). Infobae/EFE 21 Nov: Merz–Macron package struck at Dublin informal summit 12–13 Nov; on 20 Nov DE nominated Markus Brunnermeier (chief economist, replacing Lane, end-May 2027) and FR nominated Laurence Boone (market operations, replacing Schnabel who goes to IMF); Pierrakakis passed names to Costa. NO formal Eurogroup/Council recommendation yet; formal path: Ecofin recommendation (Ecofin 11 Dec) -> EP + ECB opinions -> European Council appointment, targeted 17–18 Dec (Eunews 4 Nov). So 26–27 Nov can bring at most a political endorsement, not a formal appointment. Checkable: do leaders publicly back de Cos (and the 3-seat package)? Does Knot withdraw?

Checkable: is there an MFF agreement or only 'progress'/new box (expect no deal); Ukraine 2027 financing: do all 27 back the Commission's EUR 45bn joint-debt plan or opt-outs again (CZ, SK, HU signalled refusal).
